comments.body:
DSO vs rebar PLAN-REVIEW GAP — full remediation evaluation session (2026-07)

INPUT: ~/dso_rebar_plan_review_gap_report.md (gap analysis of DSO's digital-service-orchestra planning review vs rebar's plan-review gate). GOAL: evaluate each remediation for DIRECTIONAL ALIGNMENT with rebar's architecture — many "solve problems rebar's architecture solves better at a different level." Evaluated one-at-a-time with the user; grounded in docs/plan-review-gate.md + criteria_routing.json.

GROUNDING LENS: rebar = four-pass find(P1)->verify(P2)->decide(P3 deterministic arithmetic: priority=validity x impact)->coach(P4 locked MOVE_REGISTRY). DET floor (P1-P8) is the only default-blocking tier. REVIEW_RESULT sidecar records per-finding fingerprints. Principle applied throughout: adopt DSO's CONTENT (lexicons, named FP classes, calibration idioms), never its weaker MECHANISMS (self-scored persona committees, hard-gate anti-rationalization prose, lexical word-match). Keep the generic passes (P2 contract, P4 coach) generic across findings — criterion-specific logic lives in rubrics/evidence, not shared passes.

=== KEY GROUNDING FINDINGS (from code) ===
- F1 (ac-text-quality) is BLOCKING (default_posture=blocking, block_threshold=0.7) and its checklist ALREADY has in_session_evaluable: "Evaluable in-session via repo artifacts / closing PR CI / deterministic command — not post-sprint-only." So in-session testability is already a blocking property.
- E6 already has no_hedges (LLM-tier hedge detection) + cutover_exercised_e2e; E5 has no_proxy_validation — but E5/E6 are ADVISORY (0.95). => bypass-the-real-path incomplete implementations can still slip both gates (F1 catches only the coarse post-sprint case). Noted as a SEPARATE threshold-calibration track.
- G3.coverage_map already does the 4-bucket audit (fully/partial/uncovered/structural) => the DSO "scope-gap" pattern (excluded-by-all-children/owned-by-none) is ALREADY covered.
- G4.interaction_modes already includes a consumer-impact mode => G-5/G-10/G4 consumer-enumeration is a reliability upgrade (recall->worklist), not a new mode.
- Sidecar CANNOT currently measure bin-packing contamination: it stamps each finding's criteria but throws away chunk co-residency (only a chunk COUNT survives, coverage["chunks"]). Minimal fix: stamp each finding with its chunk cohort (sorted criterion-id set) in pass1_chunk (passes.py:294-306), carry through _slim (sidecar.py:236-264).

=== VERDICTS (every item) ===
ADOPTED (grouped into 10 workstreams under epic cite-stone-sea / 9f78-ccbf-9248-4097):
- WS1 Pass-2 vocabulary expansion: NEW generic sub-answers committed_work_relies_on_unbacked_claim (unifies G-4 exclusions + G-7a confident-assertions + G-7b hedges — keys on "a committed element (AC/task/edit/exclusion) depends on the claim AND no verification-OR-fallback"; materiality via "committed element", not subjective "load-bearing") and respects_artifact_altitude (FP-1); gloss evidence_entails_finding for restatement/null-delta (FP-2). na-defaulting.
- WS2 E4 detectors + exec:DET hedge detector: G-7a confident-assertion scan-protocol lexicon; G-4 exclusion sub-check at NORMAL priority (user: elevating to highest = overreach); G-7b DET hedge detector deduped vs E6.no_hedges, verifier judges SUBSTANCE not word-presence.
- WS3 Enumeration-overlay pattern: G1/G2 as code-grounded ROUTER emitting an overlay trigger; a DEDICATED overlay enumerates the invisible affected set in its OWN context window. Instantiated for G-5 (new-prohibition -> outlawed call sites) and G-10 (new ref/event/schedule -> workflow trigger filters + release-infra). This design (user's) is more reliable than the report's lexical trigger.
- WS4 DET-floor verify-command blacklist (G-3a): mechanically-checkable file-inspection/unanchored-grep/unquoted-metachar defects; polyglot fail-open abstain.
- WS5 Rubric enrichments (prompt-only): E6 verify-cmd defect taxonomy + corrected-command anchors; T3 (G-8) three empiricism axes + four-class evidence scale — T3-LOCAL (Pass-1 evidence[] + sidecar), ZERO Pass-2 change (generic likelihood grader reads richer evidence), spike stays Pass-4; G3 (G-11) three-part coverage standard + bypass/narrowing/partial patterns; T5c/T10 (FP-3a) ambiguity-not-absence access framing; T11 post-rollback SCHEMA-STATE assertion + DATA LOSS RISK; E2 defaultable-gaps coaching; G4 consumer-enumeration precursor.
- WS6 Reviewer self-calibration anchors: G-9 small-scale default + prohibited-reasoning + two-directional bar (A1/T5a); FP-3b explicit one-way blast_radius ratchet on the verifier.
- WS7 Prompt-hardening pass (eval-guarded): R-6 affirmative-framing/pink-elephant (organizing principle) + G-12 shared-scaffolding prompt-injection directive + FP-3c uniform forward-looking rule.
- WS8 Coach moves: ADD foundation/enhancement split (fidelity axis, distinct from move 7 scope axis); SHARPEN move 9 for verifiable-proxy. DROP DEFERRED_MEASUREMENT as a move — it is counter-architectural (would coach ACs that F1.in_session_evaluable BLOCKS and the fail-closed completion verifier cannot certify); post-hoc validation instead becomes a discovered_from follow-up ticket, keeping the current ticket in-session-closable.
- WS9 Sidecar cohort field (R-1 part 1): the observability prerequisite; unblocks fort-wisp-wren.
- WS10 Docs + authoring (R-3, R-5): R-3 document the stage-by-stage asymmetric-error invariant (so tuning cannot align two skepticisms); R-5 registry-derived longer-form Markdown authoring guide (section-keyed, CI-parity-gated) + anchored deep-links in coach output + --help epilog URL + rebar explain <criterion-id> across CLI/MCP/library + anchored-refusal idiom. Sequenced AFTER criteria work.

ROUTED TO DEDICATED DESIGN/PLACEHOLDER EPICS:
- G-1 conflict detection + G-2 oscillation (folded together) -> grumpy-gland-rose (1464-bd32-07a3-4225). Design tension: deterministic-over-coach-(move,subject)-tuples vs the report's new LLM pass.
- G-6 cross-ticket interaction -> only-crave-art (bd83-c56f-1f72-4ef2), enriched with DSO four-tier severity + named-resource/sub-file-region FP discipline + staged DET->LLM build. Confirmed: belongs OUTSIDE the gate (a per-ticket reviewer can't see the store).
- R-1 part 2 config-flagged per-criterion context isolation -> fort-wisp-wren (ca57-1627-85ed-484c). Evidence-gated on WS9's cohort data.
- R-4 -> spin-cub-usher (65dd-e93b-666a-4caa): reframed from "cite bugs in rubrics" to a project-adaptive calibration-example library (core + project overlay, learns over time). Open Qs: injection point(s), bounded-growth curation.

REJECTED (with rationale):
- R-2 double-verify blocking findings: misreads DSO — its committee = perspective DIVERSITY (distinct concern areas), which rebar already gets from distinct CRITERIA; re-running the same narrow typed question is resampling, cost for minimal value. Revisit only if verifier flakiness proves chronic.
- T9 RETIRE-row-always-filled: nit — "never retired" is the sensible default for a blank value.
- Section 7 items (persona committees / hard-gate prose / >=80% word-match): rejections confirmed — rebar's arithmetic-decide, code-enforced gates, and ISF semantic match are each strictly better.

NOTED, NO ACTION (separate track): E5.no_proxy_validation / E6.cutover_exercised_e2e are advisory => bypass-the-real-path incomplete implementations can slip both gates. Whether to elevate toward blocking / share one testability bar across both gates = threshold-calibration, handled outside this epic.

TICKET STRUCTURE CREATED: epic cite-stone-sea + WS1..WS10 stories (win-attic-wren, orb-jet-folk, catty-noun-lyre, male-welt-inlet, glad-gloom-bog, neat-spa-ulcer, snappy-yew-strafe, sip-thorn-epoch, dork-quota-zeal, rife-feint-canal), 4 relates_to links to the design/placeholder epics.

REMEDIATION of plan-review findings on the 10 WS stories (review run 2026-07; NOT re-reviewed per instruction).

Review outcome first: DET floor (P1-P8) PASSED on all 10. WS1+WS4 verdict=PASS; the other 8 came back INDETERMINATE due to HTTP 429 rate-limiting on the agentic verifier (coverage.verify_failed=true) -- Pass-1 findings preserved unverified, NOT confirmed defects. So remediation treated all LLM findings as advisory.

Universal fixes applied to all 10:
- P9 (no file_impact) x10: set-file-impact recorded on every story with verified real paths.
- E6/F1/F4 hedged ACs: every 'eval confirms'/'drift-parity stays green' AC rewritten to name a concrete proving command (pytest tests/unit/test_plan_review_evals.py -k <case>; python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry validate-routing; grep/jq/diff structural checks).
- Provenance cluster (E4/G1G2/T8 'identifier not in codebase'): added a ## Provenance note to each story stating G-*/FP-*/R-*/WS-* are gap-report/session tags (this log + ~/dso_rebar_plan_review_gap_report.md), not code symbols; concrete code targets named inline + in file_impact.

Substantive per-ticket corrections from code-grounded findings:
- WS1: sub-answers live in shared review_kernel (GRADED_BINARY verify.py + validity decide.py), not plan_review-local; respects_artifact_altitude clarified as a graded validity input (not a veto); 'both variants' = the 2 verifier prompt files.
- WS2: exec:DET SCANS CODE (Engine B), not plan-prose, AND DET findings BYPASS Pass 2 -> hedge-detector mechanism reframed as an open design decision (exec:DET-into-verifier vs 1-TURN finder); committed_work_relies_on_unbacked_claim marked as introduced by WS1 + depends_on WS1 link added.
- WS4: DET_CHECKS frozen P1-P9 (ADR 0016, test-asserted) -> extend p6, do not add P10.
- WS5: T9 RETIRE rejection moved out of AC list (orphan-AC fix); eval-test consumers enumerated; nine E6 patterns + four T3 classes required to be enumerated in-prompt.
- WS6: exact one-way blast_radius edit locations named (both verifier prompts + SeverityAttrs doc); two-directional eval AC.
- WS7: scope = the 41 plan_review_*.md (reviewer's ~59 counted code-review too); NO shared-scaffolding layer exists -> must introduce a shared-preamble composition point first; forward-looking rule is in F1 only (not E1).
- WS8: MOVE_REGISTRY canonical in review_kernel/coach.py AND mirrored in docs/plan-review-gate.md table -> lockstep update; F1-blocking phrasing clarified.
- WS9: findings emitted by pass1_chunk AND pass1_container AND pass1_isf (all three must stamp cohort); _slim is a key-allowlist; out-of-tree callers eval_solver.py + criterion_preview.py flagged.
- WS10: R-3 vs R-5 flagged as splittable distinct deliverables; parity gate only covers routing JSON today -> must be EXTENDED for the guide; explain error-states specified.

Not re-reviewed (per instruction). Rate-limit-induced INDETERMINATEs were an artifact of running the batch too hot, not ticket quality.

comments.body:
Session: diagnosed + fixed ticket-store concurrency corruption; closed epic REB-601.

## 1. Closed epic REB-601 (main-name-crowd) through the completion verifier
- All 17 children were closed, but the close was BLOCKED: two children (diss-ale-jet/ce94,
  seedy-edema-groan/b043) had been FORCE_CLOSE'd (Gerrit merges) with no completion signature,
  violating the epic AC ("children closed with signed completion verdicts").
- Re-closed both through the verifier to earn signatures (diss-ale-jet is a bug → needed
  "Fixed:" reason; seedy hit a transient 429, retried). Then re-closed REB-601 → PASS.
- Note: REB-601 closed but UNSIGNED (certifiable:false) because 13/17 children were historically
  closed without completion signatures. Closed on its own criteria; not certified.

## 2. Filed bug f193 (saggy-pupil-plant) for the concurrency corruption + ran /joe-debug

Symptom: `rebar fsck` reported ~2929 issues (2398 SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT, 530 ORPHAN_EVENT,
1 MISSING_CREATE); b043 read `open` while carrying a completion-verifier signature.

PROVEN ROOT CAUSES (3 distinct; flock is local-only and never covered these cross-machine paths):
- RC1 (SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT): the Jira reconciler CI workflows (reconcile-bridge.yml +
  reconcile-bridge-canary.yml) fetched the tickets branch shallow (--depth=1) and reconciled
  with `git rebase`. Shallow graft defeats git merge-base → rebase re-applies the reconciler's
  stale pre-compaction worktree over a laptop COMPACT commit, resurrecting the source event
  files compaction deleted while keeping the SNAPSHOT. Proven by production git artifact
  (commit 51e0a578c single-parent off COMPACT 3afe230a0, re-adds 8 byte-identical deleted
  files; 8-present/2-absent = stale-fetch-boundary fingerprint) AND a controlled experiment
  (only shallow+rebase corrupts; full+merge and full+rebase clean; shallow+merge fails safe
  rc=128). Deeper enabler: compaction hard-os.remove()s folded files (compact.py:142) instead
  of the documented `*.retired` rename (invariant I1, docs/concurrency.md:35-36,154 — which
  explicitly says "merge unions cleanly, rebase conflicts"). `.retired` was never implemented.
- RC2a (ORPHAN_EVENT false positives, ~519): compaction folds only KNOWN_EVENT_TYPES but fsck
  flagged ANY pre-snapshot event absent from source_event_uuids → REVIEW_RESULT (reducer-ignored)
  falsely flagged. Deterministic, single-clone.
- RC2b (ORPHAN_EVENT genuine, ~11 remaining): concurrent write on a stale base gets an HLC ts
  below a peer's snapshot horizon; a clean merge keeps it as a pre-snapshot event that replay
  silently skips → real data loss (invariant I9 unsatisfiable across un-synced clones).
- Correction: the b043 "open + signature" symptom was NOT missing-event corruption — it was a
  legitimate reconciler STATUS closed→open (Jira-authoritative reopen).

Method: 3 parallel investigators (code-tracer, historical, empirical) + my own git-artifact
verification + a controlled shallow/full × merge/rebase reproduction matrix.

## 3. Shipped fixes #1 + #3 (LANDED on main via Gerrit change 318, commit 5a7548a, MERGED)
- Fix #1: both reconciler workflows → full history (fetch-depth: 0, no --depth=1) + `git merge
  --no-edit` (not rebase). Guard test: tests/interfaces/store/test_reconcile_workflow_no_shallow_rebase.py.
- Fix #3: fsck._check_snapshot exempts non-KNOWN_EVENT_TYPES from ORPHAN_EVENT (symmetric with
  compaction) while still flagging genuine KNOWN-type orphans. Tests:
  tests/interfaces/store/test_fsck_snapshot_checks.py (RED→GREEN + mutation-tested).
- End-to-end replication: live-store ORPHAN_EVENT dropped 530 → 11 (11 remaining are genuine
  KNOWN-type -EDIT.json orphans). SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT keeps growing until fix #1 DEPLOYS
  (next reconcile run on new main); the ~2400 existing inconsistencies still need remediation.
- Both Gerrit gates green (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1); submitted → merged → replicated to GitHub.

## 4. Created placeholder epic adept-hedge-stain (ace2-f784-4b19-4f22) for deferred work
- #2 implement `*.retired` non-destructive compaction (durable class-fix for RC1)
- #4 snapshot-horizon-safe reconciliation (RC2b data loss)
- #5 remediate the already-corrupted live store (drive fsck to zero; gated on #1 deploy)
Linked discovered_from f193.

## 5. Env fix
- The .venv was an editable install with stale metadata (0.5.2) and missing dev tools (no mypy,
  which blocked the pre-commit typecheck gate). `make install` (venv active) → nava-rebar 0.7.0
  editable + mypy/coverage/grimp/pytest-cov + re-wired hook. The `unknown key` config warning is gone.
- Chose `make install` over `pip install nava-rebar==0.7.0` (the released wheel would strip the
  editable install + the local fix and contradict dev-env guidance).

## Gotchas for next session
- This shared checkout is contended: a concurrent session switched it to branch
  feature/completion-file-impact-commit-gate mid-work (working tree briefly showed pre-fix
  content). My change was already committed + landed server-side via Gerrit, so nothing was lost.
- Shell state (venv activation) does NOT persist between tool calls — `source .venv/bin/activate`
  in every command, or make install/commit hooks use system python and fail (PEP 668 / missing mypy).
- Gerrit REST as JoeOakhartNava: fetch cred with username pinned, then curl -u; submit =
  POST /a/changes/<n>/submit.
